finalText:
**Small repo, five files, wired in a straight line.**

```mermaid
graph LR
  A[server.js] -->|checks token| B[auth.js]
  A --> C[routes.js]
  C -->|reads| D[cache.js]
  C -->|writes| E[store.js]
  D --> E
```

- **`server.js`** — starts the web server, checks each request's login token, hands good ones to the route table.
- **`auth.js`** — makes and checks those tokens. A shared secret signs a user ID, no password lookup involved.
- **`routes.js`** — the route table. Reads (get a user, list orders) go through the cache. Writes (post an order) go straight to storage.
- **`cache.js`** — a small in-memory cache, 256 items, keeps the most recently used, never expires on its own.
- **`store.js`** — stands in for a database. Just memory, and each record disappears 15 minutes after its last write.

Worth knowing: the cache never expires on its own, but the store does after 15 minutes. A cached user or order list can keep showing up even after the store has quietly dropped it.
